items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: And besides that, Redmen and I, we'd go out ourselves and walk.

ctx.x: And they play jazz in Russian?

I'm telling you, when I'm talking to some of you they're playing just like us. They're playing Sedition and some of them are playing Dixieland. And they have the all-in-folk songs. Like when you're in the hotel you stay and you go in the dining room where they have, you know, bands just like that. They use their folk songs and some of them switch around to, like I tell you, I did my time, but different types of music. You see? And they're very ordinary. Very ordinary. It's like it's supposed to be. I don't see…
They said, no, I'm from the state in New Orleans. And I said, no, no.
